Chapter 596 - 596 Blame; Wolf-Hearted

Chapter 596 - 596 Blame; Wolf-Hearted

596 Blame; Wolf-Hearted

The entire space was instantly filled with the thick smell of blood.

Then, an emotionless voice rang out.

[First to kill a level-two Unicorn Rhinoceros. You’ve been rewarded with a level-two treasure chest.]

[First to kill a level-two Unicorn Rhinoceros. Air quality in Hua Nation has improved by 10%.]

“Kung fu!” Sam shouted excitedly.

“Hua kung fu!”

Sam held the hilt of his sword and kept making sword movements. He also made sound effects with his mouth, which was very funny.

“Master, what move is this? It’s too powerful!

“Can I learn this move?

“How long will it take to do what you did?

“Master, when did you start practicing?”

“Master…”

Sam was so excited that he asked a few questions.

Initially, Lin Fan had wanted to reply.

In the end, he chose to give up.

Lin Fan did not know if Sam would ask more questions after he answered one.

That would be too noisy.

Lin Fan opened the treasure chest.

“20 points of Constitution. Do you want to use them?”

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—200 Constitution points.]

Lin Fan’s muscles moved slightly, and his strength increased slightly.

He then glanced at Sam and said, “Put your hand on this ball of light.”

20 points of Constitution was useless to Lin Fan, and they were not very useful to the Heavenly Hound either.

He might as well give them to Sam.

This way, his efficiency of collecting firewood at night should be much faster.

Sam had no idea what 20 Constitution points were.

He could not watch the live broadcast and had never killed a ferocious beast before.

However, he had always listened to Lin Fan.

Therefore, without any hesitation, he reached out and touched the ball of light.

Instantly, Sam’s power skyrocketed.

He looked at his muscles, which had clearly become thicker, and his face was filled with disbelief.

Then, Sam said excitedly, “Strength imparting? This is strength imparting, right?

“Thank you, Master!

“Master, you’re finally willing to take me as your disciple.”

After saying that, he directly knelt on the ground.

Lin Fan looked at his excited expression and suddenly wondered if he had made a mistake by giving Sam 20 Constitution points.

Lin Fan sighed. “This isn’t imparting strength, nor am I taking you in as a disciple. This is just a reward for killing a beast in the Otherworld.”

“Get up first.”

Sam acted as if he did not hear the words and just said, “Yes, Master.”

At this moment, Augustus, who had almost fallen to the ground, finally came back to his senses after panting heavily.

He wiped the sweat off his forehead and thought back to his previous sorry state. It must have been broadcasted live.

No!

He had to think of a way to turn things around. Otherwise, his image would plummet and he would lose a large number of fans.

Thinking of this, Augustus shouted at Lin Fan in English, “Who told you to attack? Mind your own business!”

Lin Fan’s brows twitched slightly as a cold look flashed across his face.

Sam immediately shouted back in English, “What did you say? My master saw that you were being chased, so he saved you. Instead of thanking him properly, you actually insulted my master? Who gave you the guts?”

“Save me?” Augustus did not back down. “Who needed him to save me? I was just playing with this rhinoceros, just like a cat playing with a mouse!

“If I wanted to kill it, I could have done it easily!

“The reward for killing him should belong to me!

“The air quality in my country should be improved by 10%!”

Augustus’ tone became even more arrogant.

These words were originally meant to deceive the audience watching the live broadcast.

However, at this moment, it was as if he had chosen to believe them himself.

Lin Fan’s face turned even colder.

A cat playing with a mouse?

Ridiculous!

At this moment, Lin Fan suddenly realized that Augustus’ head was completely enveloped by a black aura.

Death was about to descend!

The rage and anger in Lin Fan’s heart dissipated instantly.

After all, there was no need for him to be angry at someone who was about to die.

So, Lin Fan said to the Heavenly Hound and Sam, “Let’s go.”

As he spoke, he walked forward.

Seeing that Lin Fan was about to leave, Sam did not say anything else and quickly followed.

Augustus clamored. “What? You’re leaving after snatching someone else’s things?”

When Lin Fan heard that, he slowly stopped. His cold eyes swept over.

If he said one more word, Lin Fan would not mind bringing his misfortune forward!

For some reason…

At this moment…

Augustus felt as if he had fallen into an abyss. His entire body trembled, and he was so scared that he did not dare to say anything else.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan slowly turned around and continued walking forward.

After Lin Fan had walked far away, Augustus heaved out a sigh of relief.

At this moment, he realized that his entire body was completely soaked in sweat.

Augustus muttered in his heart, ‘He… Who is he?’

…

In Nashland’s live broadcast room.

Carl: [So Augustus was toying with the Unicorn Rhinoceros. I knew it.]

Fendi Gaia: [Augustus is simply an excellent actor. He’s my idol!]

YY: [Augustus is right! The reward for this Unicorn rhinoceros should’ve belonged to him. The air quality in our country should’ve been improved by 10%! Damn it!]

Mi Ke Lan: [That person seems to be Lin Fan. He’s called God Lin.]

Red: [What God Lin? He only relied on luck to kill two ferocious beasts and accumulate strength in the early stages. How could he be as powerful as Augustus?!]

Xiongya: [If Augustus had killed the beast this time and obtained 20 Constitution points, he would definitely not be inferior to Lin Fan! Damn it!]

Gene: [Lin Fan’s a thief!]

Michit: [That’s right! Thief!]

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

“What?!” Xiao Bing said angrily. “God Lin saved him, but he’s blaming Professor Lin instead!”

As a host, she should not bring in her personal emotions.

However, at this moment, Xiao Bing was a little unable to control herself.

The bullet comments in the live broadcast room covered the entire screen like a heavy downpour.

Water: [F*ck! That fair-skinned person is so inhuman!]

Men Don’t Cry: [Damn it, he was clearly about to be hit by the rhinoceros before God Lin attacked. Yet he still said he was just playing around. Don’t be shameless!]]

Grace: [Shameless!]

Mr. Huang: [Ahhh! I’m so angry! I just went to take a look at Nashland’s live broadcast room. Many of them said that God Lin is a thief!]

Great Fortune: [Thief? F*ck! Don’t they have any shame?]

No Fragrance: [Are they blind? Didn’t you see that fair-skinned man in such a sorry state?]

Heart Cultivation: [Such a heartless person will definitely not have a good ending. Just watch!]
